purpose: Supplies the whole modeled toolhead's clearance envelope to the Sculpted plate's head replay.
reference_body_model: cargo run -p hsm-sandbox --example h2c-toolhead -- DIR, DIR/h2c-left-active.step.npz
scope: Stock moving H2C head with the standard left nozzle active, every modeled body: the lower height map's, with the rest of each body folded in. Nozzle coordinates are at the active tip, with positive Y toward the back. The head shape comes from product photographs and its vertical clearances are estimates.
